## Summary

**Redesign selectors and navigation**

Full IDs, blank optional selectors, numeric prefixes and color-only active states create dense navigation.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P1**
- Wave: **V2**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P1-04`
- DUX code: `DUX5-13`

## Scope

All dashboards.

Screenshot groups: SG-01..SG-07 nav + selectors

## Concrete change

Sticky breadcrumb, short ID, contextual chips, responsive overflow and active underline/icon/bold.

## Expected effect

Context stays legible at 100% and 125% zoom.

## Acceptance criteria

- No clipping at three target viewports; active tab remains distinguishable in grayscale.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Grafana variable and dashboard-link configuration.

## Risk

Responsive behavior must be verified in actual browser.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

Nav/selector redesign residual after DUX4-22 nav bus restore.

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX5 epic (#7116)
